addon.name: CoreELEC: Network watchdog (connman restart on boot)

extension.summary: Restarts connman if no LAN IP shows up within 60s of boot
extension.description: Run this once from Program add-ons. Installs a systemd oneshot service (network-watchdog.service) and its script to /storage/.config/ on this CoreELEC box. At every boot it waits up to 60s for a 192.168.x.x LAN IP (ignoring WireGuard/OpenVPN/PPP tunnel interfaces); if none appears, it restarts connman and checks again. Fixes boots where the network never comes up on its own. Idempotent - running it again just confirms the files are already installed and the service enabled. Not a Kodi/skin fix - a system-level boot reliability fix, same delivery mechanism (a one-time Program add-on) as the other patches in this repo.
extension.news: 1.2.0: now also runs a one-time check at Kodi boot (added the xbmc.service extension point) instead of only ever running when the user manually opens it from Program add-ons - offers the same install confirmation automatically once per box, and if accepted, immediately offers to reboot the whole box right then (a systemd service, not a Kodi feature, so a plain Kodi restart isn't enough) instead of just telling the user to do it themselves later. Only ever asks once, even on "no". 1.1.1: install confirmation now explicitly says a full SYSTEM restart is needed (not just Kodi) - the previous "runs automatically on the next boot" wording didn't make clear the user needs to actually reboot the box, not just restart Kodi, matching the clearer restart wording every other add-on in this repo already uses. 1.1.0: added a settings screen with explicit Install and "Stop and remove service" actions - Kodi has no uninstall hook for script add-ons (clicking Uninstall in the add-on browser just deletes this add-on's files, it never runs any of our code), so the systemd service and script this addon installs to /storage/.config/ would otherwise keep running forever regardless of whether the Kodi addon itself is still installed. Run "Stop and remove service" BEFORE uninstalling. 1.0.0: initial release - packages the network-watchdog systemd service confirmed working on x96max+.
